votes.motion: Enter into Closed Meeting for attorney-client matters that are privileged pursuant to Utah Code § 78B-1-137, and for other lawful purposes that satisfy the pertinent requirements of the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
votes.description: The Council voted to enter a closed session to discuss attorney-client privileged matters and other lawfully permitted topics under the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
The Council voted to conclude the closed session and return to open meeting.
